items.title: Al Gallodoro Interview, 1966-05-10
items.q: Bundy told me back in the 30s, he says Fetterson someday, he loved Fetterson, he says he is going to end up president of Selma in this country, and he certainly did.

ctx.x: Jack Fetterson. Oh, Jack Fetterson. Ah, forget her. F-E-double-D-E-R-S-E-N. S-E-N. He's now the president. He, Jack Fetterson, Bundy told me back in the 30s, he says Fetterson someday, he loved Fetterson, he says he is going to end up president of Selma in this country, and he certainly did.
And Fetterson is president of Selma? Becquard? He is president of Selma?
